comment: Two source gates, two egress paths, as draft-decide-run. `repeat`: a runner MUST evaluate these activations against input.lg this many times and check that every run's per-gate verdicts, master decisions and log trace equal `expected` and `log` (SPEC §7.5, rule 1). It then evaluates the same activations once against each `file` in `permutations` (relative to this vector's directory) and checks that the per-gate verdicts and master decisions equal `expected` (rule 2) and the log equals that entry's `log` (rule 3). Each activation here reaches one gate, so the pipe relation over the activated gates admits a single topological order and the permutation's log equals the top-level log. A determinism vector has no expected.json.
